description: reconcileProvisionalDisbursement (skills/economy/lending/lib/lending-verify.mjs:119-133, unmodified by this fix but made reachable against a REAL provider for the first time by this fix's own REQ-118b rpcUrl wiring) treats ANY on-chain USDC Transfer log whose `from` topic equals loanRow.lender_wallet and `to` topic equals loanRow.borrower_wallet, found anywhere inside the bounded block window, as proof 'this specific stuck loan row was actually disbursed' -- matchesTransferLog (lending-verify.mjs:33-44) checks address+topics only and NEVER compares the log's own decoded value (extractValueUsd, lending-verify.mjs:58-62) against loanRow.principal_usd. Any OTHER, unrelated USDC transfer between the SAME two wallets within the lookback window (e.g. a completely different payment, a repayment of a PRIOR loan, or -- concretely, not hypothetically, for TODAY's actual first-loan pair -- the colony's own already-documented Franklin<->Franklin2 on-chain gig transaction, memory `project_p2_witness_achieved_franklin_to_franklin.md`, 'first on-chain gig trade Base mainnet') would be misattributed by defaultReconcile/resolveStaleProvisioning (lending-orchestrator.mjs:104-121) as evidence the stuck loan_Franklin_1 row was genuinely disbursed, landing it 'active' with a WRONG tx_hash (the unrelated transfer's), while the intended borrower never actually received THIS loan's principal_usd -- a silent bookkeeping corruption, and in the opposite direction (a genuine same-wallet-pair unrelated transfer masking a row that should have been marked disbursement_failed so a fresh, correctly-sized attempt could proceed) a form of money mis-accounting, not merely a UI nit, on the exact ledger this fix exists to make trustworthy for a first REAL loan.
testGap: skills/economy/lending/lib/__tests__/lending-verify.test.mjs:237-255 (PROP-106g/PROP-106h) only exercises a fixture where the mocked Transfer log's own valueBase (20000) happens to equal loanRow.principal_usd*1e6 (0.02*1e6=20000) -- the test never asserts a mismatched-value transfer between the same two wallets is REJECTED, because the implementation has no such check to test.
